body.title: Qualify combined progress and legacy compatibility
body.summary: Exercise both producers through real daemon routing and the in-process path with controlled providers and verified test origins. Run the integrated verification sweep after focused task checks.
acceptanceChecks: Concurrent workflow and analysis preserve attempt and project isolation and retain authoritative terminal outcomes. Check a quiet owner, worker exit, observer loss, authorization denial, pending admission and persistence failure.
Legacy compatibility holds with observation active, absent, refused and failing. Provider invocation counts stay unchanged.
Run the backend build and full backend test sweep once the tasks are complete. Record the exact tested revision, outcomes and evidence.
Check that pre-existing S1 records require no rewrite and a daemon without active S2 producers still serves the legacy contract.

tests.name: S2 real daemon routes concurrent workflow and analysis progress to isolated observers
S2 legacy workflow and analysis outcomes survive absent refused and failing observation
S2 production runtime preserves S1 records and adds no provider calls
